metadata.title: Software Supply Chain

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing risks introduced through third-party and open-source software components.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Software supply chain security, provenance, and dependency governance technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for identifying, evaluating, and constraining software supply chain risk.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Software supply chain controls mitigate ATT&CK techniques that exploit upstream software dependencies.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Supply chain governance aligns with D3FEND software composition and provenance verification techniques.

metadata.remarks: Software Supply Chain defines the capability to identify, assess, and verify third-party and open-source software components used in institutional systems. Control realization is expressed at the capability level to ensure traceable and enforceable supply chain risk management.

components.title: Third-Party Software Identification
components.description: Identification of third-party, open-source, and externally sourced software components.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Third-party and open-source software components are identified and documented prior to use.

components.title: Supply Chain Risk Evaluation
components.description: Assessment of security and operational risks associated with software dependencies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Risks associated with software supply chain dependencies are evaluated and addressed.

components.title: Artifact Provenance Verification
components.description: Verification of software origin, integrity, and authenticity prior to deployment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Software artifacts are verified for provenance, integrity, and authenticity before use.
